description: PD 6694-1 integral abutment earth pressures by the limit-equilibrium route (K*, cl.9.4.3/9.4.4) with the PD 6694-1 Integral Abutment plugin's own engine: thermal movement and design displacement, the route (A1/A2, or B / review when Annex A is needed), applicability checks, coefficients, and the four states EXPMAX/EXPMIN/CONMAX/CONMIN (force, peak pressure, resultant, moment per metre). Needs no model.

foundationType.description: Decides the route: footings/bank pads → Route A; piles/embedded walls → Annex A (SSI).

group.description: Structure group holding the abutment wall plates.

abutmentType.description: "frame" (full-height frame, default), "bank pad", "end screen" or "embedded" (embedded walls are outside the K* method).

expansionLength.description: Length to the point of zero movement, m (default 60).

gammaBulk.description: Backfill bulk unit weight, kN/m³ (default 18; typical 18 to 20).

gammaQ.description: γQ, cl.9.4.2 partial factor on the thermal movement (default 1, the unfactored case; expected 1 to 1.5).

gammaSat.description: Backfill saturated unit weight, kN/m³ (default 20; not below gammaBulk).

hasWaterTable.description: A water table behind the wall (default false); its depth is waterTableDepth.

override.description: Engineer's route override {route, engineer, reason} — only with the user's justification.

phiInferiorDeg.description: Inferior φ' for K0,max, degrees (default null = phiCritDeg).

phiSuperiorDeg.description: Superior φ' for K0,min, degrees (default null = phiPeakDeg). Must not be below phiInferiorDeg.

psi.description: ψ, cl.9.4.2 combination factor on the thermal movement (default 1, the unfactored case).

skewDeg.description: Skew, degrees (default 0). 0 to 30 for the K* method; the SSI route needs a square wall.

surchargeKpa.description: Surcharge added to σ'v behind the wall at every depth, kPa (default 0).

waterTableDepth.description: Water table depth below the retained surface, m (default 2; used only when hasWaterTable).

name: pd6694_route_a
title: PD 6694-1 Route A earth pressures
